tools.name: get_supplier_capabilities
tools.description: Returns Cintra Supply's supported categories, accepted inputs, and the quote-to-order flow available over this server.

tools.name: submit_rfq
tools.description: Submits a parts list for a wholesale quote and returns an rfq_id. Poll get_quote(rfq_id) until status is 'ready'; the priced quote is also emailed to buyer_email. Non-binding; no charge occurs at this step.

unit.description: Unit of measure, such as each, case, box, ft, or roll

part_number.description: Manufacturer part number, SKU, NSN, or catalog number

alternates_allowed.description: Whether Cintra Supply may propose clearly labeled alternatives

buyer_email.description: Email to receive the quote and order records

account_number.description: Existing Cintra Supply account_number from a prior request, to be recognized as a repeat customer

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Returns the current state of a quote. status is 'pending' while it is being priced, 'ready' once priced (with total and line pricing), 'accepted' once ordered, or 'expired'.

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Accepts a 'ready' quote and returns an order_id. When online payment is enabled it also returns a secure payment link the buyer completes; otherwise Cintra Supply emails the invoice to the buyer.

rfq_id.description: The rfq_id of a quote whose status is 'ready'

confirm.description: Must be true only after the buyer has reviewed the quote total and authorized the purchase

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Returns an accepted order's status: awaiting payment, paid, or awaiting an emailed invoice; with amount and any payment link. Fulfillment updates are added to the record as they occur.
